properties: Original closes only after the destination is ready and the original is rechecked idle and alone; core ends only the admitted terminals; one owner of the desk after every outcome; an unconfirmed end or cleanup is reported
assessment: The controller awaits each port serially under a per-source service lock, so no internal completions interleave. A 108-outcome matrix (start, recheck during start or pinning, close, cleanup) checks desk ownership and reporting; a source changing during startup, a child started after admission and a lost kill reply run against the real core kill path.
remaining: Independent Worlds, service crash during a handoff and real harness startup are not proved; the owner check on a real Herdr TUI and herdr-core covers the native paths.
